en.text:
Being in Combat for #e${12-#d} seconds grants a Stack of 'Chaos Reshaped' for 7 seconds. Maintaining the first Stack for #e${12-#d} seconds grants a second Stack. Buff can be activated while stowed.

For Chaos Reshaped, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds.

Benefits at Chaos Reshaped x1 and x2:
• x1: grants 20% increased damage
• x2: grants 35% increased damage and grants a periodic burst of healing

enhanced (
var d = 0.5
#e Each Stack is gained 0.5 seconds sooner.
)

<bold Healing effect is bugged! /> 
While Chaos Reshaped x2 is active: 
Stowing the weapon or keeping it readied for 7 seconds grants a continous healing effect of 5 HP per second.

Stowing this weapon grants the effect for 1 to 7 seconds (cycling, it's complicated), while keeping it readied after activation makes the healing effectively constant.

<purple/> While this healing effect is active, <bold NO OTHER SOURCE OF HEALING CAN RESTORE THE FINAL [~35 to 5] HP OF YOUR HEALTH BAR! /> 

This unrecoverable HP segment can only be healed by Chaos Reshaped's 5/HPs effect.

For more details, visit the perk description in the <link Destiny Data Compendium [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WaxvbLx7UoSZaBqdFr1u32F2uWVLo-CJunJB4nlGUE4/edit?gid=1662574278#gid=1662574278] />.
